resolved_independent_findings.title: Returned writer/pool reopen errors left detached writes or split read/write generations usable
resolved_independent_findings.independent_mechanism: SQLite3.53.1 control actually commits through a detached old writer after a real reopen failure; the authoritative path lacks that successful write. query_only refuses the same write. See sqlite-mechanism.json.
resolved_independent_findings.resolution: Writer becomes query_only before the destructive window. Old read pool is withdrawn. Both fresh resources must succeed before either is installed; otherwise new reads and writes fail closed and fresh IndexDb::open is the explicit recovery boundary.
resolved_independent_findings.test_result: Original two fault controls 0 pass/2 fail; fixed cc-db lib191 pass/0 fail/2 owned-child entrypoints ignored by ordinary harness.

resolved_independent_findings.title: A delayed real corruption report could quarantine successfully repaired and republished bytes
resolved_independent_findings.resolution: Bounded cache.get under the namespace lease preserves a current verified Hit. Actual corrupt or incomplete residue still follows quarantine, and I/O errors propagate. No recursive lease or new DB lock inversion.
resolved_independent_findings.test_result: Original new test failed with quarantined_current_object=true; fixed integration6/0 includes all three seeds and exact healthy bytes plus retrieval/epoch assertions.
resolved_independent_findings.fixture_change_review: An old unit manufactured CorruptReport for healthy bytes. It now flips real payload bytes before obtaining the report; original move/report/result assertions remain.

lock_and_failure_review.order: Cache namespace OS lease -> per-handle DB writer mutex. Rebuild uses writer mutex -> read-pool write lock; generation reads occur before taking the pool write lock. Rebind does not call self.read_conn.
lock_and_failure_review.lease_scope: Cache put/verified read/CAS, recovery/reconcile cache reuse, GC refresh/mark/unlink, explicit discard and quarantine share the persistent namespace lock inode. No provider call occurs under that lease.
lock_and_failure_review.cross_process_boundary: Namespace file locking coordinates participating cache publishers/GC across processes. It does not create global cross-process rebuild exclusion. semantic_rebuild.rs already requires owner/caller serialization between rebuild and fenced publication; freshness and rename are not atomic across independently opened handles/processes. This pre-existing boundary is retained and not falsely closed.
lock_and_failure_review.borrowed_reads: Previously borrowed old-generation read connections cannot be revoked. After reopen failure all new borrows are refused; no claim is made to change existing snapshot isolation.
lock_and_failure_review.gc_absence: symlink_metadata errors other than NotFound propagate; absent candidates count neither as protected nor deleted; non-NotFound unlink failures remain visible.
